set.body:
Objective
Resolve every source-breaking or semantic API decision before the first compatibility baseline.

Acceptance criteria
- Fixed-rank indexing, mutable update, and transpose have a deliberate compile-time contract.
- Dynamic-rank fallbacks remain available through checked explicit APIs.
- Rank, axis, permutation, narrow, and checked-construction failures follow one documented error philosophy.
- Multi-axis reduction semantics and scheduling are planned once through a validated axes value.
- Mutable reshape copies at most once and unsigned formatting exposes logical values.
- Additive post-1.0 ideas are separated from changes that would require later removal or semantic breakage.
- All child tickets are closed and compile-time API tests pass on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: EPIC: Freeze the ravel-core 1.0 public API
